summary: This bill establishes the Veterans Economic Opportunity and Transition Administration within the Department of Veterans Affairs to manage programs related to veterans' economic opportunity, including vocational rehabilitation, educational assistance, housing loans, and the Transition Assistance Program, and creates an Under Secretary position to lead this new administration.
